propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate analysed the metered energy data of twenty-four commercial buildings at a building services company for three years under the team's analysis procedure, identifying savings measures with their expected savings, and prepared the monthly performance report for each landlord.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the performance report document the analysis and the reports.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate monitored the contracted savings against the baseline monthly and raised two shortfalls to the account director concerned, and coordinated measure proposals with the site engineers with the approvals and contract commitments staying with the account director.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the approval records and the reference call document the monitoring and the approval boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each measure proposal for the site engineers.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the proposals document the limitation sections.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the analysis, the reports, the monitoring, the proposals and approval boundary, and the limitation sections.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: proposals by the candidate, approvals and contract commitments by the account director; the packet makes no judgement.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the energy data platform references so the savings register entries can be checked at the site visit.
